mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and nephrotoxicity, which may be exacerbated by systemic corticosteroid effects on electrolyte balance and renal function; prednisolone ophthalmic has minimal systemic absorption but topical steroids may contribute to immunosuppression during foscarnet therapy.
action: Monitor electrolytes, renal function, and serum calcium/magnesium levels closely during concurrent use; prednisolone ophthalmic is generally safe but avoid prolonged systemic corticosteroid therapy concurrently with foscarnet.
